notes: §2002:7.2.2 SR1 'A compiler directive shall be specified on one line, except for the EVALUATE and the IF directives' reaches the 2002-only FLAG-85 and FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directives: a column-7 continuation of either is refused at 2002 (COBOL2696 at line 21, pinned build --std 2002), and the one-line forms with a multi-line >>IF compile and print A/B/IF-ONE as derived.
